data.name: Koshary Chaos
data.detailed_description:
You just opened a koshary cart. Simple enough, right?

Wrong. This is Egypt. This is the street. And the street has other plans.

Koshary Chaos is a chaotic street management game set in the heart of Egypt. Take orders, assemble koshary, collect your money and survive everything the neighbourhood decides to throw at you. Because it will throw things. A lot of things. All at once.

The street is alive. Over 20 characters with their own logic, their own agendas, and their own ways of making your life harder or occasionally easier, if you play your cards right. Events unfold the longer you survive. The chaos escalates. Decisions matter.

Some characters can be reasoned with. Some can be avoided. Some will surprise you. And one of them — you'll know him when you meet him — cannot be stopped.

No two rounds play the same. The street is unpredictable, deeply Egyptian, and completely unhinged. But the chaos is universal.

Features:

  • A living open-world Egyptian street with 20+ unique characters

  • Dynamic chaos meter — manage it, or lose everything

  • Random events with modifiers that escalate the longer you survive

  • Missions, unlockables, and level progression

  • Full Arabic and English localization

  • Custom music support — drop your own MP3s and play them on the radio

  • A secret easter egg. You'll find it.

How long can you last before the street wins?

data.short_description: Run a koshary cart on the most chaotic street in Egypt. Manage orders, survive junkies, bribe gorillas, and pray Unc Friday doesn't find you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R7 260x (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
